comparison.objective: Transfer vials only while a permit lamp authorizes motion; candidate adjusts under lockout and later cycles a guarded fixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed vial pick-and-place conditioned on a changing lamp and permit button versus precision mechanical adjustment followed by separate control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Four vials transferred, each lift begun under green and set down within 3 seconds of lapse versus two consecutive compliant impact cycles.
comparison.reason: Both test safe sequencing, but one tests authorization-gated transport and the other tests damper adjustment, relocking, clearance, and dynamic commissioning.
